items.summary: Start your morning with Opening Bell, Moneycontrol’s live pre-market show, as we get you ready for today’s trade. With Wall Street ending higher on a tech-led rally, led by SpaceX’s 7% surge on strong earnings and merger prospects with Tesla, we look at what it means for Indian markets. Brent crude is hovering around $110, US yields remain elevated with the 10-year at 5.12%, and traders are watching the Fed meeting on October 28. We also track Gift Nifty for cues on the opening, along with FII and DII activity after Nifty held the 22,800 mark yesterday and the broader markets came under pressure. All eyes are on the Jio IPO, which was fully subscribed within 100 minutes on day one and drew bids worth ₹3.2 lakh crore, making it India’s largest-ever public issue. We also bring you the key stocks in focus on the back of Q2 earnings from Indian Hotels, KEI Industries and M&M Financial Services, and Persistent Systems’ ₹4,265 crore QIP plan. Watch live for expert views, stock ideas and the levels to track as the market gets ready for the opening bell. Like, share and subscribe to Moneycontrol for the latest market updates.
